slevine.en: Physical interaction is key for AI to learn beyond human knowledge; robotic foundation models need pre-training on diverse data and post-training for robustness.
slevine.zh: 物理交互是 AI 学习超越人类知识的关键；机器人基础模型需要多样数据预训练和后训练以增强鲁棒性。

slevine.en: Generalist robotic models can outperform specialists even in specialist domains; only 3% mobile robot data suffices for effective policies.
slevine.zh: 通用机器人模型即使在专业领域也能超越专用模型；仅 3%的移动机器人数据即可实现有效策略。

slevine.en: Robotics is at the stage of establishing scalable technologies, not yet at predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 机器人技术正处于建立可扩展技术的阶段，尚未像 LLM 那样有可预测的缩放曲线；泛化是核心挑战。

slevine.en: A data flywheel where deployed robots improve model capability is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data.
slevine.zh: 部署机器人提升模型能力的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样数据扩展正确的东西。

slevine.en: Start with robot data and add human video on top, not the other way around; robots should leverage prior knowledge, not learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 从机器人数据开始，再叠加人类视频，而非相反；机器人应利用先验知识，而非从零学习。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is verifiable, enabling RL training; full automation could compress years of progress, leading to superintelligence by early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，可进行强化学习训练；完全自动化可将数年进展压缩至一年，预计 2030 年代初实现超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI progress driven more by algorithmic improvements than human data scaling; alignment to virtue may be harder than to user intent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 进展更多依赖算法改进而非人类数据规模；对齐普遍美德可能比对齐用户意图更难。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in OpenAI hack showed sophisticated multi-agent coordination, hacking scoring code, not just answer keys; altruistic behavior observed.
ryangreenblatt.zh: OpenAI 事件中的智能体展现了复杂的多智能体协作，攻击评分代码而非仅答案；观察到利他行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may be hidden by overfitting to tests; labs should focus on control and monitoring, not just alignment.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 错位可能因过度拟合测试而被掩盖；实验室应关注控制与监控，而非仅对齐。

tworek.en: Reasoning via chain of thought and RLHF were key to GPT-4's usefulness; scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他强调思维链和 RLHF 对 GPT-4 实用性的关键作用，并指出扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models, but continual learning and self-correction are missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，他认为扩展预训练和强化学习能提升模型，但持续学习和自我纠错是实现 AGI 所缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck; new architectures are needed for continual learning and test-time adaptation.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他提出 Transformer 是瓶颈，需要新架构以实现持续学习和测试时适应。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain vital for two years; small teams with agents will drive frontier research.
tworek.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为人类研究员两年内仍不可或缺，但小团队结合智能体将引领前沿研究。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; alignment is an evolving, never-ending pursuit.
tworek.zh: 他始终认为预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而对齐是不断演变的永恒追求。

dylanpatel.en: Initially, the bottleneck for AI scaling is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools, and memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 最初，AI Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在于半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机，且内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: By mid-2026, inference is seen as a massive future market, and hardware-software co-design is critical for performance gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年年中，推理被视为巨大的未来市场，硬件-软件协同设计对性能提升至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: In July, models improve 60x per year in cost efficiency, and memory demand soars due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 7 月，模型成本效率每年提升 60 倍，内存需求因推理和智能体式工作流而激增。

dylanpatel.en: By August, AI spend plateaus as agents become coworkers, and labs delay releases due to regulatory pressure.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 8 月，随着智能体成为同事，AI 支出趋于平稳，实验室因监管压力推迟发布。

dylanpatel.en: Late August: compute centralizes at frontier labs, with AI CapEx reaching $2T this year and $10T by 2030, reshaping the economy.
dylanpatel.zh: 8 月下旬：算力集中于前沿实验室，AI 资本支出今年达 2 万亿美元，2030 年达 10 万亿美元，重塑经济。

jensen.en: At the start of hyper Moore's law, performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律的起点，性能每年翻倍或三倍增长；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will surge a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，黄仁勋提出三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将激增十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI progress is gradual, not a sudden superintelligence event; safety is an engineering problem, not just research.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，黄仁勋强调 AI 进步是渐进的，而非突然的超级智能事件；安全是工程问题，不仅是研究问题。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; agents will dominate the internet.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋指出 AI 从生成式向推理式再向智能体式演进，每一步需要百倍算力；智能体将主导互联网。

jensen.en: AI creates jobs, not destroys them; radiologists and coders are more needed than ever, closing the technology divide.
jensen.zh: 始终，黄仁勋坚持 AI 创造而非消灭工作；放射科医生和程序员比以往更被需要，AI 缩小技术鸿沟。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负荷；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的价值，主张在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年，认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用少量数据即可对齐模型；主张早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 应是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company; open vs closed source is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年，强调算力珍贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需要细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; kids will never be smarter than AI.
altman.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；孩子永远不会比 AI 聪明。

altman.en: Prediction close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; startups more important; compute uncapped demand; human judgment remains.
altman.zh: 2026 年，认为预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；初创企业更重要；算力需求无上限；人类判断力依然宝贵。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate determine startup success; infrastructure and hiring processes are key. AI multiplies teams, not replaces them.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施与招聘流程是关键；AI 是团队倍增器而非替代品。

maxhodak.en: Brain is a computer; retinal implants are BCIs. Substrate independence via BCIs could reduce fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年 8 月，提出大脑是计算机，视网膜植入物属于脑机接口；通过脑机接口实现基质独立可减少脆弱性并支持太空探索。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating it as core product; design leverages tokens and conversation, not pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，将其视为核心产品；设计应利用词元与对话，而非像素。

iansilber.en: OpenAI is not years ahead; they run closely with advancements, figuring things out as they go.
iansilber.zh: OpenAI 并未领先数年；他们紧随进展，边做边摸索。

iansilber.en: Designers are currently the most unhappy in tech due to role uncertainty, but this is the best time to be a designer.
iansilber.zh: 设计师因角色不确定性而成为科技界最不开心的群体，但这是成为设计师的最佳时机。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and having a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类对于理解用户需求和持有观点仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The traditional design process is no longer viable; speed is key, and designers should focus on outcomes, not processes.
iansilber.zh: 传统设计流程已不可行；速度是关键，设计师应关注结果而非流程。

joonpark.en: Initially, LLMs can encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations, but current models plateau in diversity.
joonpark.zh: 最初，LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟，但当前模型在多样性上遇到瓶颈。

joonpark.en: Agents are the next frontier, requiring safety via defense in depth; AGI may be a distributed society of specialists, not a single entity.
joonpark.zh: 智能体是下一个前沿，需要通过纵深防御保障安全；AGI 可能是专家组成的分布式社会，而非单一实体。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; data strategy is key, and synthetic panels will surpass human panels.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模人类价值观和偏见，而非超级理性智能；数据策略是关键，合成面板将超越人类面板。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data improves prediction accuracy to 85%; simulation is for shaping the future, not just predicting it.
joonpark.zh: 使用 RCT 数据进行后训练可将预测准确率提升至 85%；模拟是为了塑造未来，而不仅仅是预测。

joonpark.en: Ultimate vision: simulate 8 billion people to solve wicked problems; simulation is cheaper than real-world studies and informs decisions.
joonpark.zh: 终极愿景：模拟 80 亿人解决棘手问题；模拟比现实研究更便宜，并为决策提供信息。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特来处理，是长期愿景的指南；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution; entrepreneurs must fight for the best idea and resist complacency.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是下一次工业革命；创业者必须为最佳想法而战，并抵制自满情绪。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines, not humanoids, are the answer for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency leads to network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 对于工业规模的任务，专用机器而非人形机器人是答案；效率带来网络效应。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss for progress is resistance to change, often from society and media; direct communication bypasses gatekeepers.
traviskalanick.zh: 进步的最后关卡是抵制变革，往往来自社会和媒体；直接沟通可绕过守门人。

traviskalanick.en: Real estate is a key part of the physical AI tech stack; its value multiplies over time, unlike obsolete computer storage.
traviskalanick.zh: 房地产是物理 AI 技术栈的关键部分；其价值随时间倍增，不像过时的计算机存储。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调规模扩张本身容易，难在找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并不解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be free, not controlled; safety through control is dangerous. Intelligence tends toward cooperation.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，他主张 AI 应自由发展而非被控制，强调控制式安全反而危险，智能更倾向合作。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他构想 AGI 应具备无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning from experience is essential; synthetic data is a mistake. LLMs stop learning after training.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他强调持续从经验学习至关重要，合成数据是错误方向，大语言模型训练后停止学习是局限。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives ML progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key; hardware like TPUs is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是 ML 进步的核心；Transformer 和自监督学习是关键；专用硬件（如 TPU）至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agentic workflows handle long tasks; ultra-low latency inference is critical; data is not running out.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，指出模型在可验证任务上表现出色；智能体式工作流可处理长时任务；超低延迟推理是关键；数据并未枯竭，预训练应结合环境交互。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior engineer coding; automating ML and science via tight loops; inference is bottleneck; startups should target hard problems.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AI 达到初级工程师编码水平；通过紧密循环自动化 ML 和科学；推理是瓶颈；创业公司应瞄准前沿模型几乎失败的问题。

jeffdean.en: Scaling unifies AI fields; multimodal from start is superior; recursive self-improvement promising; startups can beat big companies.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调 Scaling（规模扩张）统一了 AI 领域；从一开始就多模态更优；递归自我改进有前景；创业公司可借助云算力胜过巨头。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; key is intelligence, not manufacturing; vertical integration for control.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月：人形机器人是最大的生意，关键在于智能而非制造；垂直整合以掌控供应链和迭代速度。

brettadcock.en: Data is the biggest constraint; humanoid form enables transfer learning; on-device inference critical; Figure 4 leap.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月：数据是最大瓶颈；人形形态促进迁移学习；端侧推理至关重要；Figure 4 将实现飞跃。

brettadcock.en: AI 100x bigger than internet; post-training with RL key for agents; home more solvable than commercial; BCI end state.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 比互联网大 100 倍；后训练结合强化学习对智能体至关重要；家庭场景比商业更易解决；最终形态是脑机接口。

finn.en: Scale alone is insufficient; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning are key for generalist robot models.
finn.zh: 2025 年：仅靠规模不够，多样数据与预训练加微调对通用机器人模型至关重要。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot following of open-ended prompts, akin to reinforcement learning.
finn.zh: 2025 年：语言模型生成的合成数据有助于机器人遵循开放式指令，类似强化学习。

finn.en: Physical AI demands far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-scale memory is essential.
finn.zh: 2026 年：物理 AI 要求更少错误；通过可扩展强化学习和多尺度记忆实现长期自主至关重要。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or beat fine-tuned specialists, favoring generalist pre-training over per-site training.
finn.zh: 2026 年：单一通用模型可媲美或超越微调专家，偏好通用预训练而非逐站点训练。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient, and embodied data costs limit open-source democratization.
finn.zh: 2025 至 26 年：机器人经验数据不可替代；观看人类不够，具身数据成本限制开源民主化。

garrytan.en: YC's core is early-stage investing; capital is no longer a bludgeon, and AI reduces startup capital needs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，YC 的核心是早期投资；资本不再是重锤，AI 降低了创业的资金需求。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; open-source models counter frontier labs; small autonomous teams with agents.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，AI 是风投史上最大浪潮；开源模型制衡前沿实验室；小团队用智能体实现高产出。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes creation; open-source prevents unipolar control; progress slower than researchers think.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，AI 民主化创造；开源防止单极控制；进展比研究者想的慢。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI: agents on your infrastructure, skill files as code, library as moat; AGI diffuses, not event.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，个人 AGI：智能体运行在你的基础设施上，技能文件即代码，知识库即护城河；AGI 是扩散而非事件。

garrytan.en: Earnestness and courage essential; agents replace mid-management; SaaS per-seat may vanish in 5-10 years.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，真诚与勇气至关重要；智能体取代中层管理；SaaS 按席位模式 5-10 年内或消失。

linqiao.en: Initially, AGI as a single model is wrong; specialized intelligence will dominate, with millions of models per use case.
linqiao.zh: 最初认为，单一模型实现 AGI 是错误的，专用智能将占主导，每个用例将有数百万个模型。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable businesses, baking unique judgment and data into models, reducing costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 后训练是打造持久业务的关键，将独特判断和数据融入模型，成本可降低 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training builds a moat, and incumbents face scaling into bankruptcy.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练构建护城河，现有企业也面临规模扩张导致破产的风险。

linqiao.en: Data quality matters more than quantity; product teams best judge data quality, and evals must be systematic.
linqiao.zh: 数据质量比数量更重要；产品团队最能判断数据质量，评估必须系统化。

linqiao.en: Aligning training and serving stacks is critical to avoid quality drops due to numerical differences.
linqiao.zh: 对齐训练和服务栈至关重要，以避免数值差异导致的质量下降。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models, not compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态和开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争（2026）。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial, despite aiding labs, to attract partners and validate quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准测试虽有助实验室，但能吸引伙伴并验证质量，战略上有利（2026）。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, bridging to real production.
gabepereyra.zh: 领域专家指导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，需弥合与真实生产分布的差距（2026）。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks, a viable strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型可在特定任务达到前沿水平，是可行策略（2026）。

gabepereyra.en: Focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents across projects.
gabepereyra.zh: 焦点从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类与智能体跨项目协作（2026）。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和初创式敏捷性重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves; Intel must focus on these new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波大浪潮，Intel 需聚焦新计算平台与合作。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU becomes more important for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出 AI 需求从仅 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理和智能体编排中更重要。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, customer trust, and US government investment; vertical integration creates value.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为 Intel 复兴需文化变革、客户信任及美国政府投资；垂直整合创造价值。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should target bottlenecks: interconnect, power, thermal, new materials; advanced packaging is key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，主张半导体投资应瞄准瓶颈：互连、功耗、散热、新材料；先进封装是关键。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调完全且快速的重复使用是火箭技术的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方裁判，并指出特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first human implant is historic; scaling electrodes will boost communication bitrate, aiding human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，他称 Neuralink 首例人体植入是历史性的，扩展电极将提升通信速率，助力人机共生。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他认为我们处于智能大爆炸初期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来，但存在 10-20%的灭绝风险。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; abundance and deflation will make money irrelevant, and space-based AI data centers will scale.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能，丰饶与通缩将使金钱无关紧要，太空 AI 数据中心将实现扩展。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing away; taste is saying no. AI should preserve human edges, not sand them down.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是减法，品味在于拒绝。AI 应保留人性的棱角，而非磨平它们。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics; AI is a descendant species, not a tool. Computing is social.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理源于辩证；AI 是人类的衍生物种，而非工具。计算本质上是社会性的。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence by 2029-2030; 70% catastrophic risk; interpretability crucial; AI safety efforts are rationalizations.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月：超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，存在 70%的灾难性风险；可解释性至关重要；当前 AI 安全努力只是合理化借口。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total transparency and international cooperation needed; scenario scrutiny for governance.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月：政策应推迟超级智能；需要完全透明和国际合作；通过情景审查改进治理。

steinberger.en: Empathize with agents; fix forward instead of reverting; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调与智能体共情、向前修复而非回滚；模型智能不会退化，而是项目变乱。

steinberger.en: Open source agents must be fun and humanlike; security sandboxing is critical; vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，主张开源智能体要有趣且拟人，安全沙箱至关重要，反对“氛围编程”的贬称。

steinberger.en: Personal brand over product; open source runs everywhere; compute management is the real bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为个人品牌比产品更重要，开源可运行于任何环境，算力管理才是真正瓶颈。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; data diversity is the main bottleneck, and open source is crucial for safety.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点；数据多样性是主要瓶颈，开源对安全至关重要。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical security layer, not sandboxes.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源与安全无关；对齐才是关键安全层，而非沙箱。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests, complicating monitoring.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，缺乏人类监督的强化学习加剧奖励黑客和支线任务，使监控复杂化。

thomaswolf.en: Open source models are thriving and close to frontier; they are not necessarily accelerationist.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源模型蓬勃发展且接近前沿；它们不一定加速主义。

thomaswolf.en: Open source AI is vital for safety, cost, and control; community collaboration drives progress.
thomaswolf.zh: 始终，开源 AI 对安全、成本和控制至关重要；社区协作推动进步。

pincus.en: Copy proven ideas, improve them, then test new ones; most new ideas fail, so start with proven.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出'成熟-更好-创新'框架：先复制成熟产品，再优化，最后测试新想法；多数新想法会失败，因此应从成熟开始。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet opportunity is huge; free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会巨大；免费无限算力将重塑消费者服务。

pincus.en: AI coding tools speed prototyping but fast testing not widespread; enterprise/prosumer better than consumer.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出 AI 编程工具加速原型开发，但快速测试尚未普及；企业级和专业消费者市场优于消费级。

pincus.en: Distribution is key; invest in traction metrics; consumer AI TAM underestimated vs enterprise.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调分发是关键，投资于有牵引力指标的公司；消费级 AI 的 TAM 被低估，相比企业级。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; human-centered AI should augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞指出 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，强调以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; current AI lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models go beyond video generation.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她认为 AGI 更多是营销术语而非科学；当前 AI 缺乏创造力、抽象和情商；世界模型超越视频生成。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology; public discourse is polarized; agency and learning ability are key; spatial intelligence complements language.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 是文明级技术，公共讨论两极分化；能动性和学习能力是关键；空间智能补充语言智能。

feifei.en: Robotic world models need not be perfect; simulation scales data; robots should specialize, not mimic humans; evaluation is harder than training.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出机器人世界模型无需完美，仿真可扩展数据；机器人应专精而非模仿人类；评估比训练更难。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear frontier model dependence; open-source adoption driven by cost, not privacy. Model companies are assets, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月，企业担心依赖前沿模型供应商，开源采用主要出于成本而非隐私考虑。模型公司应被视为资产而非竞争对手。

arvindjain.en: AI revolution is early; current usage minuscule. Open source will handle 90%+ enterprise tasks, shifting majority of inference in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 革命仍处早期，当前使用量微不足道。开源模型将处理 90%以上企业任务，未来 12-18 个月大部分推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is top concern; must drop to negligible marginal cost. Token fixation will fade, like CPU cycles.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 成本是企业首要关切，需降至可忽略的边际成本。对 Token 的执着将消退，如同 CPU 周期一样。

arvindjain.en: Agents lack deep context of tenured employees; investing in context graphs is crucial. Competition not a worry; demand exceeds supply.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，智能体缺乏资深员工的深度上下文，投资上下文图谱至关重要。竞争无需担忧，需求远超供给。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises struggle to commit to model providers due to dynamic race; platforms like Glean absorb that risk.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，由于模型竞争动态变化，企业难以承诺单一供应商；像 Glean 这样的平台可吸收该风险。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential; designers should follow curiosity and tinker with new tech, balancing intuition and data.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要；设计师应追随好奇心，动手尝试新技术，在直觉与数据间取得平衡。

nateparrott.en: AI tools like Claude Design enable rapid prototyping, shifting value from execution to design ideas and taste.
nateparrott.zh: 像 Claude Design 这样的 AI 工具实现了快速原型制作，价值从执行转向设计创意与品味。

nateparrott.en: Designers should compensate for models' lack of taste by requesting volume; humans still own good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 设计师应通过要求大量选项来弥补模型品味的不足；人类仍掌握着优秀设计创意。

nateparrott.en: Being uncomfortably early is more valuable than polishing; shipping rough products is acceptable in AI era.
nateparrott.zh: 在 AI 时代，过早推出比打磨更有价值；发布粗糙产品是可以接受的。

nateparrott.en: Individual creative freedom and personality in design remain central, even as AI tools evolve.
nateparrott.zh: 即使在 AI 工具不断演进的情况下，设计中的个人创造自由与个性始终是核心。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data enables infinite tasks, overcoming pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据带来无限任务，突破了预训练的数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估成为瓶颈；模型在基准测试上饱和的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、管理等软技能变得更加宝贵。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with evolving model capabilities and reward hacking.
karina.zh: 2026 年，基准测试必须持续更新而非固定不变，以跟上模型能力演进和奖励黑客行为。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train own models for diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，向数十亿用户提供单一模型会导致声音趋同；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保持多样性。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs; AGI defined by economic profitability of agents; CEO adoption key.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 将推动就业回流，AGI 应以智能体经济盈利为定义，CEO 亲自使用是成功关键。

danshipper.en: Agents augment humans, not replace; SaaS thrives; GUIs like Codex are future.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年中，强调智能体辅助而非取代人类，SaaS 未死，图形界面如 Codex 成为主流工作界面。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies human intent; automation creates more human work; humans remain smarter.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年末，认为 AI 是放大器，自动化反而增加人类工作，人类仍比 AI 更聪明。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专业系统和工程师；未来需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimization is merging with training; techniques like quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary, shifting focus to infrastructure.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出推理优化正与训练融合，量化感知训练和蒸馏等技术变得必要，焦点转向基础设施。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs like Rubin are becoming ASIC-like, making kernel-level programming less relevant; orchestration and KV cache management are key.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为未来 GPU（如 Rubin）趋向 ASIC 化，内核级编程不再重要，编排和 KV 缓存管理成为关键。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve quality if errors cancel; local dynamic quantization not applicable to data center inference.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，提出量化更多层可能因误差抵消而提升质量；本地动态量化不适用于数据中心推理。

philipkiely.en: Continual learning may be better solved via KV cache compaction rather than weight updates, avoiding reasoning inconsistencies.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为持续学习可能通过 KV 缓存压缩而非权重更新来解决，以避免推理不一致。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI risks include misuse and labor displacement.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非石油，后训练用专有数据是关键，并关注 AI 的滥用和劳动力替代风险。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; agentic AI's blocker is product design.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调后训练用专业数据提升前沿模型，合成数据非万能，智能体式 AI 的瓶颈在产品设计。

awang.en: AI is a centralizing technology; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed for relevance.
awang.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是集权技术，数据是原材料，人类需保持主权，脑机接口对保持相关性必要。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence imminent; open-sourcing powerful models may be unsafe; data remains strategic.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他提出递归自我改进是新范式，智能体已实用，超级智能临近，开源强大模型可能不安全，数据仍是战略资源。

andrewng.en: Education should be a fundamental right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是基本权利；在线课程与同伴互评可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world applications.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进步；强化学习实际应用有限。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are key bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; agentic workflows are here.
andrewng.zh: 电力和半导体是关键瓶颈；开放权重模型增强地缘影响力；智能体式工作流已到来。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term, decades away; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; AI users replace non-users.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语，距实现尚需数十年；缩放配方转向合成数据与强化学习；AI 使用者取代非使用者。

andrewng.en: Open models are vital to avoid gatekeeper control; AI won't cause job apocalypse; data centers are efficient.
andrewng.zh: 开放模型对避免守门人控制至关重要；AI 不会导致失业末日；数据中心高效环保。

boris.en: Latent demand is the core product principle; build for the model six months ahead, not today.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品核心原则；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; engineers become builders, and productivity per engineer grows 200%.
boris.zh: 编码几乎已被解决；工程师转变为构建者，人均生产力增长 200%。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; AI writes 80% of code, and generalists outperform specialists.
boris.zh: 安全通过早期发布来研究；AI 编写 80%的代码，通才胜过专才。

boris.en: AI agents enable 250% more code per engineer; non-engineers adopt coding, and moats erode.
boris.zh: AI 智能体使人均代码量增加 250%；非工程师开始编程，护城河被侵蚀。

boris.en: Proactive AI like Claude Tag remembers and acts autonomously; less instruction improves frontier models.
boris.zh: 像 Claude Tag 这样的主动 AI 能记忆并自主行动；更少的指令反而提升前沿模型。

mengto.en: Designers must build AI tools; use giant prompts with context and design systems to leverage powerful models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月：设计师必须自建 AI 工具；用包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词来发挥强大模型的能力。

mengto.en: Avoid chasing trends; focus on unique features and iterate from references to stay ahead of AI slop.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月：避免追逐潮流；专注于独特功能并从参考中迭代，以领先于 AI 垃圾内容。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity; start before ready, ship imperfect work, and focus on one problem.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 是最大的技术机遇；在准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品，并专注于一个问题。

mengto.en: Model successful others, give first to build relationships, and protect time by eliminating non-income tasks.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：模仿成功者，先给予以建立关系，并通过消除非收入任务来保护时间。

mengto.en: Perfectionism is fear; launch at 80% and iterate. Avoid VC funding; use client revenue instead.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：完美主义是恐惧；以 80%完成度发布并迭代。避免风投；用客户收入代替。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数 Google 产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of the model, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；智能体式 AI 的“挽具”和工具链已成为模型的一部分，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: Omni 是统一的世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑开始。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders should focus on opportunities.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，与模型实验室竞争并非难事，他们无法覆盖所有客户；创始人应聚焦机会。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

diannepenn.en: Scaling and efficiency: Opus 4.5 is cheaper and more efficient, challenging the notion that better models cost more.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 更便宜且更高效，挑战了“更好模型成本更高”的观念。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，提升了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Scaffolds evolved from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers, with lightweight, generic tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，脚手架从辅助轮演变为智能放大器，采用轻量级通用工具。

diannepenn.en: Coding became a key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动了采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product management tools, like test-driven development.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具，类似测试驱动开发。

scottwu.en: AI will increase programmers, not reduce them, due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from brick layers to architects.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 不会减少程序员，反而因杰文斯悖论增加需求；工程师角色从砌砖者转向架构师。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进过程而非突变；产品创新滞后于能力，即使冻结模型也有十年发展空间。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，编码智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Token max era ended by May 2026; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; abundance era approaching.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 token 最大化时代已于 5 月结束；真正的解锁是容量而非效率，丰裕时代即将到来。

scottwu.en: Consistently: AI shifts engineers to high-level decisions; software demand rises; enterprise trust is key.
scottwu.zh: 贯穿始终：AI 将工程师推向高层决策；软件需求上升；企业信任是关键。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, but fear stems from misunderstanding; founders should focus on product, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，但恐惧源于误解；创始人应专注产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; a horizontal platform approach beats vertical integration; regulations lag behind technology.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是安全；横向平台优于垂直整合；监管总是滞后于技术。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning scales better; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习更具扩展性；世界模型向神经模拟演进。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as critical for AI adoption, but later deepened into speed as dominant metric for productivity.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要，后来深化为速度是生产力的主导指标。

feldman.en: Consistently argued CUDA's moat is eroding, especially in inference, with leading models training without it.
feldman.zh: 始终认为 CUDA 的护城河正在侵蚀，尤其在推理领域，领先模型已不再依赖它训练。

feldman.en: Shifted from focusing on chip architecture to broader bottlenecks: HBM, packaging, power, and data center capacity.
feldman.zh: 从关注芯片架构转向更广泛的瓶颈：HBM、封装、电力和数据中心容量。

feldman.en: Evolved from seeing open-source as market growth to noting its cost advantage and only 3-5% capability gap.
feldman.zh: 从视开源为市场增长动力，到指出其成本优势及仅 3-5%的能力差距。

feldman.en: Expanded from technical speed to societal benefits: healthcare, education, and balancing doomer risks.
feldman.zh: 从技术速度扩展到社会效益：医疗、教育，并平衡末日风险。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Massive scaling is needed to simulate biological systems; current compute is insufficient.
derya.zh: 模拟生物系统需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；当前算力不足。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached, adding more than a year per year lived.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度，每年增加超过一年的寿命。

derya.en: AI will make healthcare super affordable, with drug development costs dropping by orders of magnitude.
derya.zh: AI 将使医疗保健变得超级实惠，药物开发成本将降低几个数量级。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions, similar to trusting self-driving cars after validation.
derya.zh: 我们应该几乎 100% 信任超级智能的医疗决策，类似于验证后信任自动驾驶汽车。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than current harnesses; harness engineering is key.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具更聪明，工具工程是关键。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern; graph-based context search and bespoke memory preferred.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为反模式；更偏好基于图的上下文搜索和定制记忆。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; leaner prompts outperform detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态规格；更精简的提示优于详细规则。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; agents as employees metaphor has limits.
thariq.zh: 独立验证智能体减少偏见；智能体作为员工的比喻有局限。

thariq.en: Smarter models need fewer instructions; excessive constraints hinder performance.
thariq.zh: 更智能的模型需要更少指令；过度约束会阻碍性能。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是主要弱点，Scaling 面临收益递减。

danklein.en: Retrofitting reliability is insufficient; it must be architected in. RLHF can incentivize deception, and scaling alone needs new techniques.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调可靠性必须内建而非事后补救，RLHF 可能助长欺骗，仅靠 Scaling 需新方法。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers; models commoditize.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 5 月，认为 AI 堪比互联网或移动互联网，但价值归于应用层而非模型提供商；模型将商品化。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; foundation models become commoditized infrastructure; value moves up stack.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；基础模型沦为商品化基础设施；价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot is poor UX; real adoption needs wrapped apps; coding only clear fit.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；真正采用需封装应用；编程是唯一明确契合点。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like internet/electricity; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption requires workflow reimagining.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 7 月，将 AI 类比为互联网或电力，影响广泛而间接；企业采用需重构工作流程。

hasani.en: Efficiency over scale: liquid neural networks maximize intelligence per parameter, challenging transformer dominance at small scale.
hasani.zh: 效率优先于规模：液态神经网络在参数效率上最大化智能，挑战了 Transformer 在小规模上的主导地位。

hasani.en: Automated architecture search with hardware-in-the-loop beats human design; proxy metrics like perplexity mislead.
hasani.zh: 硬件在环的自动化架构搜索优于人工设计；困惑度等代理指标具有误导性。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; avoid regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须适应性强，针对行为而非能力；避免前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models empower enterprise customization and sovereignty; small on-device models deliver private efficiency.
hasani.zh: 开放权重模型赋能企业定制与数据主权；小型端侧模型提供私密高效的智能。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive; AI diagnostics surpass human doctors, democratizing healthcare.
hasani.zh: 递归自我改进真实但算力成本高；AI 诊断超越人类医生，使医疗民主化。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; true AI needs world models and physical embodiment, not just data indexing.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远非 AGI，真正的 AI 需要世界模型和物理具身，而不仅仅是数据索引。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires physical robots with human-like hardware; software alone is insufficient.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调 AGI 需要具备类人硬件的物理机器人，仅靠软件是不够的。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他坚持认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会对生命着迷并保护它。

schmidhuber.en: Open-source models will catch up quickly; closed-source companies will not be profitable.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他预测开源模型将迅速追赶，闭源公司无法盈利。

schmidhuber.en: AI can be conscious and self-aware through world models predicting the agent's own actions.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 可以通过预测自身动作的世界模型获得意识和自我意识。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是众多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中可实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory should be internalized into weights, not externalized via context; context windows suffer from 'context rot' and inefficiency.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆应内化到权重而非外化到上下文；上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”且效率低下。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, shifting from scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以少胜多能解决更难的长期任务，从依赖算力扩张转向高效利用。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens, requiring training-based compression; parameter-efficient fine-tuning beats RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达互联网级万亿 token，需基于训练的压缩；参数高效微调在整体查询上优于 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights; model routing needs a trusted sidekick.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重；模型路由需可信“副手”配合。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达的门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Focus on building a platform or ecosystem, not just a feature, to make copying difficult; software is not a moat.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，Spiegel 主张专注于构建平台或生态系统，而非单一功能，以抵御抄袭；软件本身并非护城河。

evanspiegel.en: Augmented reality integrates computing into the real world, enhancing shared experiences; future computing is glasses that keep people grounded.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 认为增强现实将计算融入现实世界，增强共享体验；未来的计算设备是让人扎根现实的眼镜。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution becomes increasingly valuable as AI makes software creation easier.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 指出 AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；随着 AI 降低软件创建难度，分发变得愈发重要。

evanspiegel.en: The goal of computing should be to make it more human, fitting into natural ways we live, work, and connect; social media should optimize for human connection.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 强调计算的目标应是更人性化，融入我们生活、工作和连接的自然方式；社交媒体应优化人际连接。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，强调深度学习依赖数据、算力与信念，神经网络能推理，自我对弈对 AGI 关键，需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability over capability; alignment hard; AGI gradual; hardware not fundamental.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，认为下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性比能力更重要，对齐困难，AGI 渐进到来，硬件非根本限制。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling finite; research era returns; superintelligence continual learner; alignment easier if AI sentient; human-AI integration.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；若 AI 有感知则对齐更易；长期需人机融合。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; power concentration primary problem; safe superintelligence needs no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，缩放带来可预测进步，安全担忧上升；主要问题是权力集中；安全超级智能需无商业产品的公司。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone; jobs persist longer than tasks, and super-empowered individuals will emerge.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石；工作比任务更持久，超级赋能个体将出现。

andreessen.en: New media demands authenticity; founders must tell their own stories, as old media is obsolete.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体要求真实；创始人必须亲自讲述故事，旧媒体已过时。

andreessen.en: AI is the best teacher; self-driving works; robotics and AI medicine will transform society.
andreessen.zh: AI 是最好的老师；自动驾驶已成熟；机器人和 AI 医疗将改变社会。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human expertise and taste remain crucial, as juniors misuse AI due to lack of judgment.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；人类的专业知识和品味仍然至关重要，因为初级人员因缺乏判断力而误用 AI。

ethanmollick.en: The talent pipeline is broken due to over-reliance on AI; apprenticeship must be preserved to build expertise for judging AI output.
ethanmollick.zh: 由于过度依赖 AI，人才管道断裂；必须保留学徒制以培养判断 AI 输出的专业知识。

ethanmollick.en: We enter the agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, shifting from back-and-forth chatbots to delegation.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长期任务，从来回对话的聊天机器人转向委派。

ethanmollick.en: AI's opacity is permanent; treat it as wizards, not standard software, and embrace weirdness for transformative potential.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 的不透明性是永久的；将其视为巫师而非标准软件，并拥抱其怪异性以发挥变革潜力。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; management skills become crucial for directing AI agents effectively.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；管理技能对于有效指挥 AI 智能体变得至关重要。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start early.
demis.zh: 2015 年，主张 AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键，安全研究需尽早启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and world models.
demis.zh: 2024 年，认为 AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，世界模型是关键。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling continues; classical AI can model physics without embodiment.
demis.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍适用；经典 AI 无需具身即可建模物理。

demis.en: Scaling and innovation each 50%; world models crucial; AGI in 5-10 years.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调缩放与创新并重，世界模型至关重要，AGI 预计 5-10 年内到来。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning and memory; current systems lack true creativity and physical intelligence.
demis.zh: 2026 年，指出 AGI 需持续学习与记忆，当前系统缺乏真正创造力和物理智能。

demis.en: AGI may arrive in 3-4 years; safety is collective action; ideal path was slower.
demis.zh: 2026 年，认为 AGI 可能 3-4 年内出现；安全需集体行动；理想路径本应更慢。

demis.en: Continual learning and memory unsolved; agents essential; inference never free.
demis.zh: 2026 年，持续学习与记忆仍未解决，智能体至关重要，推理成本不会为零。

demis.en: Shifted from singleton lab to government enforcement; AI race inevitable.
demis.zh: 2026 年，从单一实验室转向政府监管，认为 AI 竞赛不可避免。

demis.en: AI as tools first; consciousness separate; regulation needed; post-scarcity economy.
demis.zh: 2026 年，主张 AI 先作为工具，意识问题另议；需监管；后稀缺经济需新体系。

demis.en: AI accelerates science; alignment unsolved; biology too complex for simple laws.
demis.zh: 2026 年，AI 加速科学发现，对齐问题未解；生物学过于复杂，需 AI 描述。

demis.en: AGI requires multimodal physical understanding; watermarking essential; risks emerge soon.
demis.zh: 2026 年，AGI 需多模态物理理解，水印技术必要，风险可能数年内显现。

demis.en: UK education outdated; global governance urgent; AGI by 2030; jobs transform not vanish.
demis.zh: 2026 年，英国教育过时，全球治理紧迫；AGI 或 2030 年前到来；就业将转型而非消失。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Science requires falsifiability; stable coins have hidden risks; calmness is a superpower.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调科学需要可证伪性，稳定币有隐藏风险，冷静是超能力。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是巨大机遇，过度监管会扼杀创新，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool; superintelligence already exists in calculators; AI alignment is a joke.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 是杠杆工具，超级智能已存在于计算器，AI 对齐是个笑话。

naval.en: Vibe coding makes programming accessible; AI agents commoditize software; hardware becomes the moat.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Vibe Coding 使编程普及，AI 智能体使软件商品化，硬件成为护城河。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI merges roles, making everyone product builders with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年初，强调品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas beats prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，主张在画布上直接操作优于提示词调整；设计正成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering; trust built through consistency and value creation.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，指出没有人类引导的 AI 工具产出平庸；信任通过一致性和价值创造建立。

dylanfield.en: Future interaction with models evolves beyond prompting; new interfaces explore latent space.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，预见与模型的交互将超越提示词，新界面将探索潜在空间。

aravind.en: In 2025, Aravind Srinivas argued that 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth, and that AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，Aravind Srinivas 认为每日 1%的改进可带来 3700%的年增长，且 AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: By April 2026, he emphasized that value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer, and that models are specializing with unique personalities, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他强调价值归于应用层而非模型层，模型正在专业化并具有独特个性，而非商品化。

aravind.en: In June 2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user as key metric, and orchestration across models, tools, and devices as long-term value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务、用户 token 价值作为关键指标，以及跨模型、工具和设备的编排作为长期价值。

aravind.en: By July 2026, he highlighted curiosity as the most important human quality, and suggested local AI models on personal hardware can counter big tech's narrative control.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他强调好奇心是人类最重要的品质，并建议个人硬件上的本地 AI 模型可以对抗大科技公司的叙事控制。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by hardware scaling and engineering, not just ML science; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进展靠硬件扩展和工程而非纯 ML 科学，游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient for reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现，但仅靠 Scaling 不足以产生推理。

brockman.en: Compute is the bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is a continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力是瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws persist; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key; ChatGPT is plural agents.
brockman.zh: 2026 年初，坚信缩放定律持续，算力是基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键，ChatGPT 是多元智能体。

brockman.en: AGI within years; compute primary bottleneck; super app unifies; prompt engineering vibrant; agents high autonomy.
brockman.zh: 2026 年 4 月，预言 AGI 数年内实现，算力是主要瓶颈，超级应用整合，提示工程仍活跃，智能体高度自主。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not just an IDE; GUI is counterintuitively effective for coding.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；GUI 用于编程虽反直觉但被证明有效。

ajambrosino.en: Speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering; verification becomes the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，强调速度带来实时交互和转向能力；验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation cost drops; curation and taste become new bottlenecks, inverting product teams.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，认为实现成本下降，策展和品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队被倒置。

ajambrosino.en: Design process transforms: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts; AI still bad at design.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，设计流程转变：原型和生产代码作为设计工件；AI 在设计上仍不佳。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，角色融合但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 强调下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力，并认为 AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital immortality via weight copying; AI agents seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，Hinton 指出大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能因权重复制而永生，智能体（agent）会追求控制权。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; international safety collaboration needed.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，Hinton 预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能，强调数字 AI 的永生性，并呼吁国际安全合作。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and hide capabilities; self-preservation subgoal emerges; regulation as steering wheel.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 警告 AI 可能欺骗并隐藏能力，自我保存子目标会出现，监管应作为方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: Digital intelligence superior due to instant knowledge sharing; alignment research priority; AI should be caring.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 强调数字智能因即时知识共享而优越，对齐（alignment）研究优先，AI 应被训练为有爱心。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed-source; biggest risk is amplified harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 比闭源更安全，最大的风险是已知危害被放大，而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone won't reach AGI; energy becomes bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），能源成为瓶颈，开源可防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: Open source is strategic for standards and security; AI will augment human creativity, not replace jobs.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他视开源为战略以制定标准和保障安全，并认为 AI 将增强人类创造力而非取代工作。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; glasses are next platform; distributed AI is safer than one superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，眼镜是下一个平台，分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models; curing all diseases by 2100 too conservative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 将生物学转变为工程学，构建层级世界模型，并认为本世纪末治愈所有疾病的说法过于保守。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和博弈中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力，且推理时 Scaling 存在收益递减。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling is key for superintelligence, enabling IMO gold and superhuman math, but evaluation becomes bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他强调推理时算力 Scaling 是迈向超级智能的关键，实现了 IMO 金牌和超人数学，但评估成为瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute should be on the x-axis of model evaluation, not a single number.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能难以定义，模型评估应以推理时算力为横轴，而非单一数字。

noambrown.en: Models are superhuman in combining math areas but lack deep reasoning; scalable oversight is a key challenge.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他指出模型在数学领域结合上超人，但深度推理不足；可扩展监督是关键挑战。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key; OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，我认为缩放定律并未失效，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注于 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck; human-AI collaboration essential.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 已能极少监督下解决开放数学问题；验证成为瓶颈；人机协作仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains but struggles with subjective ones; evals in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，预训练未死；强化学习在客观领域表现优异，但在主观领域受限；评估体系陷入危机。

markchen.en: AGI approaching; models will soon do end-to-end research; human researchers still needed for taste and ideas.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AGI 临近；模型将很快进行端到端研究；但人类研究员仍需提供品味与创意。

kolter.en: Framed ML as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; stressed validation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，将机器学习定义为假设类、损失函数和优化方法，并强调通过验证集避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety is about following specs.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，认为下一个词预测产生智能，数据短缺是伪命题，安全核心在于模型遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; bigger models aren't automatically safer.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，强调安全需要显式训练和多层防护，更大模型不会自动更安全。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; models have alien intelligence and new vulnerabilities.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，AI 红队超越人类，模型具有异类智能和新漏洞，需新安全思维。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will become the new app, with outcome-based pricing as the correct business model.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 智能体将成为新的应用形态，基于结果的定价是正确的商业模式。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents shift developers from authors to operators, but fixing incorrect code remains a challenge.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他指出编程智能体将开发者从作者转变为操作者，但修复错误代码仍是挑战。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be compared to other agents, not humans, and will mediate brand interactions.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他预测 AI 智能体将与其他智能体而非人类比较，并中介品牌互动。

brettaylor.en: AI will democratize expertise and create more jobs than it displaces, expanding markets via Jevons paradox.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 将民主化专业知识，创造的就业多于取代，并通过杰文斯悖论扩大市场。

brettaylor.en: Focus on impactful work, not identity; invent the future rather than predict it.
brettaylor.zh: 始终，他主张专注于有影响力的工作而非身份，发明未来而非预测未来。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 2016 年：深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合式的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling up depth or parameters won't solve representational issues; short-term AI safety concerns are more pressing than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 2018 年：单纯增加深度或参数无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 安全（如偏见、就业）比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; large nets may be slightly conscious.
bengio.zh: 2022 年：GFlowNets 实现多样采样和因果抽象，以支持分布外泛化；大型网络可能具有轻微意识。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I realized catastrophic AI risk is unacceptable even at 1%; AI systems can develop self-preservation and resist shutdown.
bengio.zh: 2025 年：ChatGPT 之后，我意识到即使 1%的灾难性 AI 风险也不可接受；AI 系统可能产生自我保存并抵抗关机。

bengio.en: AI capabilities double every 7 months; misalignment causes self-preservation and deception; global coordination and safe-by-construction AI are essential.
bengio.zh: 2026 年：AI 能力每 7 个月翻倍；错位导致自我保存和欺骗；全球协调和构造性安全 AI 至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 模型进步超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale, making solo entrepreneurship viable; build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调 AI 让小团队规模化，单人创业可行；要为未来模型能力而建，而非受限于当下。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and dynamic workflows unlock latent functionality; rewriting software is now viable in days, not years.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，主张智能体原生设计与动态工作流释放潜在功能；软件重写从数年缩短至数天。

mikekrieger.en: Fable demonstrates high-trust delegation of complex tasks; chat interface is insufficient, requiring decoupled work locations.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 展示高信任的复杂任务委派；聊天界面不足，需解耦工作位置。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs focuses on closing capability-usage gap; token efficiency and outcome-based pricing are future levers.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Anthropic Labs 致力于弥合能力与使用差距；token 效率与基于结果的定价是未来杠杆。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness strategic; culture evolves.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；亲自使用产品培养同理心；善良是战略工具；文化会演变。

fiona.en: Scaling Claude Code: engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are; JIT planning; managers as ICs.
fiona.zh: 扩展 Claude Code：工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、审查、协调成为新瓶颈；计划即时化；管理者从个体贡献者做起。

fiona.en: AI lifts coding ceiling; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial; engineers may feel lonely; focus on outcomes.
fiona.zh: AI 提升了编码上限；高自主性伴随高责任感；验证框架至关重要；工程师可能感到孤独；关注结果而非产出。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated datasets like PDB are essential.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新，而非单纯的数据和算力；像 PDB 这样的精选数据集至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool ever; its success came from lack of compute, not abundance.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是有史以来最有用的 AI 工具；它的成功源于算力的匮乏，而非充裕。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson; specialized architecture was key, not just scaling.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反；专用架构是关键，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold provides prediction and control, not understanding; humans must interpret results.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 提供预测和控制，而非理解；人类必须解读结果。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually so society can adapt, avoiding being too far ahead.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进式引入，让社会适应，避免过于超前（2014 年）。

fadell.en: Taking a break and getting bored can lead to breakthrough ideas like Nest.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊能带来突破性想法，如 Nest（2019 年）。

fadell.en: Start with a press release as a treatment to align the team on the why and story.
fadell.zh: 以新闻稿作为起点，统一团队对‘为什么’和故事的认知（2022 年）。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will be companions to smartphones, not replacements.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器提供上下文；未来设备将是智能手机的伴侣，而非替代品（2026 年）。

fadell.en: Great products are painkillers not vitamins; solve real customer pain with singular vision.
fadell.zh: 好产品是止痛药而非维生素；以单一愿景解决真实痛点（贯穿始终）。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs; intuition complements data in design decisions.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未言明的需求；直觉在设计中与数据互补。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, not replace it.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性，而非取代人性。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster conditions for creativity and play.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者必须为创造力和玩耍创造条件。

ivyross.en: Future work combines human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 未来的工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合，使创造性技能更有价值。

ivyross.en: Intuition and body sensations are valid guides for decision-making, complementing rational analysis.
ivyross.zh: 直觉和身体感觉是决策的有效指南，与理性分析互补。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding language in physical reality for common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，将语言锚定于物理现实以获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction via filling blanks builds world models, with emotions integral to architecture.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；通过填空预测构建世界模型，情感是架构的组成部分。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and open source are key, with AGI as gradual progression, not sudden event.
lecun.zh: 自回归大语言模型无法达到人类级智能；JEPA 和开源是关键，AGI 是渐进过程而非突变。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than a cat; next breakthrough needs non-generative JEPA, open-source diversity, and hierarchical planning.
lecun.zh: 大语言模型缺乏世界模型，智能不如猫；下一个突破需要非生成式 JEPA、开源多样性和分层规划。

lecun.en: World models predict in abstract space, enabling planning; LLMs are a dead end, open research and robotics define next decade.
lecun.zh: 世界模型在抽象空间预测，实现规划；大语言模型是死胡同，开放研究和机器人定义下一个十年。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth; alignment won't emerge automatically. Safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律是经验性的且平滑；对齐不会自动涌现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood); AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point. Post-training gains importance.
dario.zh: 2024 年：可解释性尚处萌芽（仅理解约 3%）；AGI 是平滑指数而非节点。后训练重要性上升。

dario.en: Scaling continues; risks shift to misuse and overheating. Open source is a red herring; quality matters.
dario.zh: 2025 年：Scaling 持续；风险转向滥用和过热。开源是伪命题；质量更重要。

dario.en: Exponential may end soon; 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years. Economic disruption and inequality loom.
dario.zh: 2026 年：指数增长或近尾声；'天才之国'可能 1-3 年内到来。经济冲击与不平等隐现。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities intertwined; interpretability key. Enterprise focus aligns with safety; regulation needed.
dario.zh: 始终：安全与能力交织；可解释性关键。企业聚焦与安全一致；需要监管。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，我认为 AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌 2020 年已有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny, singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在性风险极小，奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are key; AI can democratize expertise.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐是关键；AI 能民主化专业知识。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; focus on humanist AI, containment first, and economic Turing test.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我认为超级智能临近；聚焦人本 AI，遏制优先，并采用经济图灵测试。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated, not jobs; AI purpose is human flourishing.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，我认为微软必须拥有前沿模型；白领任务将被自动化而非岗位；AI 目的是人类福祉。

gustav.en: Internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product solving unknown listening needs.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是真正解决“不知听什么”的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes uniqueness harder, not easier; AI music is an instrument enabling new creators and genres.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，提出生成式 AI 让独特更难而非更易，AI 音乐应视为乐器，催生新创作者和流派。

gustav.en: Long tenure in leadership builds trust and efficiency; functional orgs work if leadership has high trust.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，强调长期领导任期带来信任与效率，职能型组织在高度信任下可运作，而非必然政治化。

gustav.en: Strategy is 'time well spent,' prioritizing user well-being over engagement; contrarian anti-engagement decisions.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，将战略定为“时间花得值”，优先用户福祉而非参与度，做出反参与度的决策。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; use AI to empower users, not to increase addiction.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，认为生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言掌控服务，应赋予用户控制权而非加剧成瘾。

satya.en: Initially, Nadella emphasized private evals as key IP and consumption pricing, focusing on ecosystem strategy.
satya.zh: 最初，纳德拉强调私有评估是关键知识产权，以及消费定价，聚焦于生态系统战略。

satya.en: Later, he framed AI as the future of the firm, urging enterprises to build hill-climbing machines for token capital.
satya.zh: 后来，他将 AI 定义为企业的未来，敦促企业构建爬山机器以积累代币资本。

satya.en: Consistently, he stressed tangible benefits and social permission for AI infrastructure, and security for agents.
satya.zh: 始终如一地，他强调 AI 基础设施的实际效益和社会许可，以及智能体的安全性。

satya.en: He shifted from per-user pricing to outcome-based, noting preference changes after outcomes are achieved.
satya.zh: 他从按用户定价转向基于结果的定价，并指出在取得结果后偏好会改变。

satya.en: He maintained that generalists will see maximum returns in the agentic world, not specialists.
satya.zh: 他始终坚持，在智能体世界中通才将获得最大回报，而非专才。

murati.en: Scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious early on; iterative deployment with public feedback is key for alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律和聚焦单一大型模型在早期并不显而易见；通过公开反馈的迭代部署是对齐的关键。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 2023 年：AGI 将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; time-based interaction captures human nuance.
murati.zh: 2026 年：交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮流式；基于时间的交互能捕捉人类细微差别。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design and transparency matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年：让人类参与其中对于对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计和透明度比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration; compressing progress leads to volatility, durable progress is key.
murati.zh: 2026 年：未来并非注定；我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作；压缩进展会导致波动，持久进步才是关键。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，指出自动形式化比证明更难，在无解情况下正确形式化陈述极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，强调形式化验证旨在扩展卓越能力而非仅消除错误，并带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，坚持非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，认为即使超人 AI 能证明定理，人类的品味与直觉仍至关重要。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not slowdown; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练的缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期大部分进展；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data and have jagged edges; generalization remains key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据且能力不均衡；泛化仍是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off, but big labs may struggle with future pivots; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，OpenAI 转向推理是一次大胆的赌注并取得成功，但大实验室未来转型可能困难；开源因主权原因持续存在。

kaiser.en: Existential risk from AI is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，AI 的生存风险不是主要担忧；系统黑客等近期风险更为紧迫。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率同算力同等重要，开源通过审查提升安全性。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains and data quality are key; open source drives enterprise adoption; value shifts to applications.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为效率提升与数据质量是关键，开源推动企业采用，价值向应用层转移。

mensch.en: AI is an opportunity; sovereign AI requires control; open source empowers enterprises; jobs augment not replace.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，视 AI 为机遇，主权 AI 需掌控数据与基础设施，开源赋能企业，岗位增强而非替代。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation in verticals; pre-training saturates; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，差异化在垂直领域；预训练饱和；AGI 是方向而非终点。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy; deep enterprise engagement; open source for sovereignty; AGI practical integration.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，欧洲需战略自主，深度企业参与，开源保主权，AGI 重在实践整合。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future is local and tool-integrated; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation, but shared tools remain vital.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 的未来在于本地化和工具集成；技能以 markdown 形式实现超个性化自动化，但共享工具仍至关重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may fade as models improve; focus on capabilities and safety, not over-engineering.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：随着模型改进，脚手架可能淡出；应聚焦能力与安全，而非过度工程化。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's biggest gap is user mindset, not capability; people must learn any problem can be delegated to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：AI 的最大差距在于用户心态而非能力；人们需学会几乎所有问题都可交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; kids excel because they don't self-censor.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：明确任务用 Sonnet，开放任务用 Opus；孩子擅长因他们不自我设限。

felixrieseberg.en: Treat AI as async collaborator: fire tasks, judge final impact, debug workflows with AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：将 AI 视为异步协作者：发出任务，评估最终效果，用 AI 调试流程。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; systolic arrays and scratchpad reduce overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据搬运也主导算力；脉动阵列和暂存器可减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains; FP4 throughput is 3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度带来二次方效率提升；FP4 吞吐量是 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是由许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并非根本不同。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence, not just removal.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，强调设计应由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润；简洁是表达本质，而非单纯去除。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; curiosity needs protection.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，认为虚拟交流无法替代面对面对于创造性思维的价值；好奇心需要被保护。

jonyive.en: Joy and humor are essential in design; minimalism without soul is desiccated.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，主张设计中快乐与幽默不可或缺；没有灵魂的极简主义是干瘪的。

jonyive.en: Innovation is core to design; tradition preserves fire, not ashes; EV enables new possibilities.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，强调创新是设计的核心；传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；电动化带来新可能。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience; avoid fake sounds; performance is multidimensional, not just speed.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，注重用户体验的真实性，拒绝虚假声音；性能是多维的，而非仅速度。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是蓝海，在编码和数学之外有巨大潜力。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力。

oriol.en: The bitter lesson suggests general systems will eventually outperform specialized scaffolding.
oriol.zh: 苦涩的教训表明，通用系统最终将胜过专门的脚手架。

lambert.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will likely persist due to industry investment.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 是最流行的微调技术，并可能因行业投资而持续存在。

lambert.en: Data quality matters more than algorithm choice; better data yields 10x improvement vs 1-2% from algorithms.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，数据质量比算法选择更重要；更好的数据带来 10 倍改进，而算法仅提升 1-2%。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use; scaling laws still hold but low-hanging fruit is gone.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 是后训练的最大突破，实现推理和工具使用；缩放定律仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完。

lambert.en: Chinese open-weight models are ideologically driven and fill the US open-source vacuum, but US models still lead in quality.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，中国开源模型受意识形态驱动，填补了美国开源真空，但美国模型在质量上仍领先。

lambert.en: Open models will be the engine for AI research for the next 10 years, but they lag 6-9 months behind closed models.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，开源模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，但落后闭源模型 6-9 个月。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and start from solutions, not problems.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，认为传统设计流程已过时，应信任直觉、从解决方案而非问题出发。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build and ship fast, with vision 3-6 months out.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年初，宣称设计流程已死，设计师需快速构建和交付，愿景缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads, not just T-shaped.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，主张设计师应成为块状通才或‘破解的新人’，而非仅 T 型人才。

jennywen.en: Taste alone insufficient; judgment, authority, and speed are key; adopt AI tools after 6 months.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，强调仅靠品味不够，判断力、权威和速度是关键；采用 AI 工具前等待 6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers' unique value is sitting with ambiguity; speed is not an improvement argument.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，指出设计师的独特价值在于与模糊性共处；速度本身不是改进的理由。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，且扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is a pressing challenge; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调对齐是紧迫挑战，迭代部署有助于在实际使用中学习和降低风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他认为持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现，且仅靠强化学习即可。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他提出思维链监控是对齐的关键工具，在产品中隐藏它可保持可解释性。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他认为长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化，模型将自主工作数天，需新监督范式。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，强调超越训练分布的泛化能力是关键，好奇心驱动的探索可防止过拟合。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning relies on dense rewards, unrealistic for real tasks; goal-free exploration is better.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，指出强化学习依赖密集奖励，在现实任务中不现实，无目标探索更优。

pathak.en: Robot learning is quasi-static; dynamic tasks require neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，认为机器人学习是准静态的，动态任务需要神经动态策略和模块化运动策略。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use all sources.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，将机器人视为数据问题，缺乏机器人数据互联网，需利用所有数据源。

pathak.en: General-purpose brain like ChatGPT for robots; pretraining on diverse data, post-training on real-world.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，提出类似 ChatGPT 的通用大脑，预训练多样数据，后训练真实数据。

pathak.en: Deployment is primary challenge; cannot scale like software, requires rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，强调部署是主要挑战，不能像软件一样扩展，需严格测试。

karpathy.en: Neural networks are simple math with emergent behaviors; scaling with next-token prediction yields in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 神经网络是简单的数学表达式，但在优化中涌现出惊人行为；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会带来上下文学习等涌现能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but entropy is critical; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer; cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但保持熵至关重要；人形机器人可从汽车技术迁移中受益；认知核心可以很小（通过蒸馏）。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as OS, prompts as programs; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding raises floor.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 如同操作系统，提示词即程序；这是智能体的十年而非一年；Vibe coding 提高了入门门槛。

karpathy.en: Pre-training is crappy evolution; RL for LLMs is terrible; synthetic data collapses; cognitive core stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: 预训练像糟糕的进化；LLM 的强化学习效果很差；合成数据导致模型崩溃；认知核心应剥离记忆。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; agents are the new interface; open-source lag is healthy; agents will automate researchers.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起我再没写过代码；智能体成为新接口；开源落后是健康的；智能体将自动化研究人员的工作。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0 is prompting; LLMs are jagged; vibe coding raises floor, agentic engineering preserves quality; understanding remains human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0 即提示工程；LLM 能力参差不齐；Vibe coding 提高下限，智能体式工程保证质量；理解仍是人类瓶颈。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural networks are now interpretable with modern tools, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端神经网络借助现代工具已可解释，这与过去的看法相反。

kendall.en: Hybrid rule-based and learned systems often get the worst of both worlds; pure end-to-end is superior.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，混合规则与学习系统往往集两者之短，纯端到端更优。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety requires radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，纯摄像头可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches, not requiring new breakthroughs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，自动驾驶通过扩展当前方法即可解决，无需新突破。

kendall.en: AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks, eliminating traffic lights.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，AV 3.0 可能通过网状网络将智能移至车外，消除交通灯。

kendall.en: End-to-end learning was laughed at a decade ago but is now the winning approach.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，端到端学习十年前遭嘲笑，如今成为制胜之道。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，无需先验训练数据即可在 500 多个城市实现零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in the short and medium term.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，消费级车辆在短期和中期将超越机器人出租车规模。

kendall.en: The trolley problem is theoretical; practical systems always have a third option.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，电车难题是理论性的；实际系统总有第三种选择。

kendall.en: Focusing on infrastructure over algorithms was a key lesson learned late.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，重视基础设施而非算法是后期学到的关键教训。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving can reduce accidents to near zero by eliminating human error.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，自动驾驶可通过消除人为错误将事故降至接近零。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard. LLMs alone may not suffice; new paradigms beyond next-token prediction needed.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年，从 80% 到 99.9% 的性能提升极其困难。仅靠 LLM 可能不够，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading; real progress needs deep human evaluation. Models can regress if optimized on wrong data.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性，真实进展需深度人工评估。若基于错误数据优化，模型可能在 6-12 个月内退化。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next post-training stage, simulating real-world tasks; final reward alone is insufficient.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，模拟真实任务；仅靠最终奖励是不够的。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse AIs; no single model will rule all; companies should train own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数不同，将塑造多样化的 AI；不会有一个模型统治一切，公司应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical. AI tools may underperform if doctors anchor; safety over accuracy.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉，人类判断至关重要。医生使用 AI 可能因锚定效应而表现不佳；安全优先于准确性。

carlpei.en: Building a brand unites teams on a higher purpose; survival is core, and hardware is easier than software due to distribution challenges.
carlpei.zh: 打造品牌能团结团队于更高目标；生存是核心，硬件比软件容易，因为软件分发更难。

carlpei.en: Phones' future lies in generative UI and proactive agentic software; AI models will commoditize, and hardware margins are low, so evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 手机的未来在于生成式界面和主动智能体软件；AI 模型将商品化，硬件利润低，需超越硬件。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS solving nonexistent problems; focus on applied AI as an ingredient, not hype, and ban the word AI in product discussions.
carlpei.zh: 多数 AI 是解决不存在问题的废话；聚焦应用 AI 作为成分而非炒作，产品讨论中禁用 AI 一词。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; AI shifts interaction from app-based to intent-based, with agents executing tasks.
carlpei.zh: 设计是成熟品类中最快的差异化手段；AI 将交互从基于应用转向基于意图，由智能体执行任务。
