carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interfaces could kill them. Apps will disappear, so open APIs for AI agents.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机不会被眼镜取代；只有脑机接口才能终结它。应用将消失，需为 AI 智能体开放 API。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题，而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我认为大语言模型的幻觉在搭配真值检测器时，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我认为大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我认为基于强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 始终，我认为可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 等科学突破并非必需。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 2025 年，强调模型即产品，应像软件一样快速迭代、每日发布，以从真实用户反馈中学习。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; AI will render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 2025 年，认为聊天不是终极界面，AI 应生成自己的 UI 并融入现有工具，类似从 MS-DOS 到 Windows 的演进。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 2025 年，主张安全与产品速度分离：前沿模型严格把关，产品开发则最大化加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，将长期留存视为北极星，增长源于减少摩擦、产品投资和模型改进三方面。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 2026 年，认为服务下十亿用户需要主动式、高交互性的产品，而非简单聊天机器人。

nando.en: AI should augment human abilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，强调 AI 应作为增强人类能力的工具，从视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest challenges; no solutions yet, requiring open collaboration.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，始终强调 AI 安全与负责任部署是最大挑战，尚无解决方案，需要开放合作。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy issues in AI; local language models can revolutionize education; human skills matter.
nando.zh: 2026 年，指出非洲在 AI 领域跨越了遗留问题，本地语言模型可革新教育，人文技能同样重要。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs are like operating systems.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，强调具身对 AI 接地气、减少幻觉至关重要；将大语言模型比作操作系统。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is best for low-level control, while LLMs handle high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，认为强化学习最适合底层控制，而大语言模型负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，指出机器人领域数据是主要瓶颈，未来在于通过仿真和世界模型生成合成数据。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test—robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，提出物理图灵测试（机器人打扫凌乱房间）是具身 AI 的重大挑战。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning progresses well, but system one low-level control remains hardest in embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，认为系统二（推理）进展良好，但系统一（底层控制）仍是具身 AI 最难点。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文被低估，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能显著提升智能。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is a key breakthrough, enabling expert-level performance and new skills.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，能实现专家级表现并习得新技能。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not just capability, is the main bottleneck; coding is the leading indicator for AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体的可靠性而非能力是主要瓶颈，编码是 AI 进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis alongside pre-training; simple RL methods work best for language models.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我提出强化学习是与预训练并列的新扩展轴，且简单 RL 方法对语言模型最有效。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; compute is the bottleneck; software-only singularity possible.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使工具和编排更重要，算力是瓶颈，软件单点奇点可能实现。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better algorithms and data can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；拥有更好算法和数据的较小模型可以超越较大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safe, pleasant responses.
yejin.zh: 基于互联网数据的预训练提供了广泛知识，但结合 RLHF 的后训练对于安全、令人满意的回答至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI methods interpolate human knowledge, not transcend it.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 方法只是内插人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning, especially during pre-training, improves reasoning and can yield lasting gains despite compute costs.
yejin.zh: 强化学习，尤其是在预训练阶段，能提升推理能力，尽管算力成本高，但能带来持久收益。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; small models with diverse synthetic data can rival frontier models.
yejin.zh: 多元对齐尊重人类价值观的多样性；拥有多样化合成数据的小模型可以媲美前沿模型。

truell.en: Natural language won't be the primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会成为主要编程方式；示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next major AI progress driver.
truell.zh: 测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要 AI 进步驱动力。

truell.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 编程将从代码转向更高层次的意图描述，人类仍处于主导地位。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost reasons.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其是出于速度和成本考虑。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and will take decades to unfold.
truell.zh: AI 变革将比互联网影响更大，且需要数十年才能完全展开。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编码以建立同理心并加快交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; design systems are semantic, not just libraries.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；设计系统是语义化的，而非单纯的组件库。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate its role in winning, and invest in brand early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人需阐明其制胜作用，并尽早投资品牌以吸引人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; avoid structured crits, prefer organic feedback to maintain velocity.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型而非克隆；避免结构化评审，偏好有机反馈以保持速度。

henrymodisett.en: In fast-growing startups, gut decisions often beat data-driven ones; adapt process to problem, not template.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，认为在快速成长的初创公司，直觉决策常优于数据驱动；流程应适应问题而非套用模板。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI is a creative partner; code is source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴；代码是唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, paid iteratively; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，需迭代偿还；快速粗糙的实验能最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; small teams beat cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; side projects can outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应展示工艺与意图，而非流程；副项目可胜过传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；不采用如同忽视早期互联网。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. PhD and critical thinking are key paths.
leike.zh: 2018 年：强调 AI 安全的重要性，认为实证研究尚不充分，博士训练和批判性思维是进入该领域的关键路径。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年：认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需可扩展监督和可解释性，并指出对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient. External oversight and raising misuse costs are needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年：批评 OpenAI 安全文化滑坡，后训练不足以解决对齐问题，呼吁外部监管并提高滥用成本。

shazeer.en: Next-token prediction is AI-complete; scaling compute and data yields smarter AI, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为下一个词预测是 AI 完备问题，扩大算力和数据能让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部机理仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Scaling laws persist, but algorithmic advances and inference-time compute scaling are equally vital for progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他坚持缩放定律，但强调算法进步和推理时算力扩展同样关键，推动模型代际提升。

shazeer.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures for efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他预测未来模型需处理万亿级上下文窗口，并采用模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: AGI requires agentic action and reinforcement learning, not just passive data; test-time compute alone insufficient.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 需要智能体式行动和强化学习，而非被动数据；仅靠推理时算力扩展不够。

shazeer.en: Open-source models narrow gap with frontier; AI self-acceleration via coding and bottom-up compute allocation.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他指出开源模型缩小与前沿差距，AI 通过编码自我加速，且自下而上的算力分配更利于突破。

abbeel.en: Self-play and imitation learning are powerful for robot skill acquisition; deep RL benefits from piecewise linear control.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调自博弈和模仿学习对机器人技能获取的强大作用，并指出深度强化学习的成功部分源于分段线性控制。

abbeel.en: Combining unsupervised learning with RL improves sample efficiency; hard-coding prior knowledge can limit performance.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出将无监督学习与强化学习结合可大幅提升样本效率，并认为硬编码先验知识可能限制性能。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns transferable to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他观察到预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式。

abbeel.en: A consistent theme: leveraging learning signals (self-play, imitation, unsupervised) to improve robot learning.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：利用学习信号（自博弈、模仿、无监督）来改进机器人学习。

abbeel.en: He cautions against over-reliance on hard-coded knowledge, advocating for data-driven approaches.
abbeel.zh: 他始终警惕过度依赖硬编码知识，倡导数据驱动的方法。
